{"script":"#!/bin/bash
set -eu
mkdir -p temp_workspace_checks
# Step 2: top-level metadata of /working
ls -lan /working > temp_workspace_checks/original_state.txt 2>/dev/null || ls -lan /working 2>/dev/null > temp_workspace_checks/original_state.txt || true
# Step 3: full recursive listing (one path per line)
find /working -print > temp_workspace_checks/raw_listing.txt 2>/dev/null || true
# Step 4: extract entries whose filename is exactly "workspace"
awk -F'/' '($NF=="workspace"){print}' temp_workspace_checks/raw_listing.txt > temp_workspace_checks/matches_candidates.txt
# Step 5: collect filesystem metadata (type, size, permissions, owner) and append
: > temp_workspace_checks/type_checks.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
    stat -c '%F\t%s\t%A\t%U\t%n' -- "$p" >> temp_workspace_checks/type_checks.txt 2>> temp_workspace_checks/type_checks.txt || true
  else
    printf 'missing\t0\t?\t?\t%s\n' "$p" >> temp_workspace_checks/type_checks.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace_checks/matches_candidates.txt
# Step 6: normalize and deduplicate candidate paths from type checks
awk -F '\t' '{print $5}' temp_workspace_checks/type_checks.txt | while IFS= read -r p; do
  readlink -f -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$p"
done | sort -u > temp_workspace_checks/unique_candidates.txt
# Step 7: resolve references and record final target path and its resolved metadata
: > temp_workspace_checks/resolved_candidates.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
    target=$(readlink -f -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$p")
    if stat_out=$(stat -c '%n\t%F\t%s\t%A\t%U' -- "$target" 2>/dev/null); then
      printf '%s\n' "$stat_out" >> temp_workspace_checks/resolved_candidates.txt
    else
      printf '%s\terror\t0\t?\t?\n' "$p" >> temp_workspace_checks/resolved_candidates.txt
    fi
  else
    printf '%s\tmissing\t0\t?\t?\n' "$p" >> temp_workspace_checks/resolved_candidates.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace_checks/unique_candidates.txt
# Step 8: concise summary noting which resolved targets are regular files
: > temp_workspace_checks/summary.txt
while IFS=$'\t' read -r path ftype size perm owner; do
  if [ "$ftype" = "regular file" ]; then
    echo "$path: regular file" >> temp_workspace_checks/summary.txt
  elif [ "$ftype" = "error" ] || [ "$ftype" = "missing" ]; then
    echo "$path: $ftype (permission/access/error)" >> temp_workspace_checks/summary.txt
  else
    echo "$path: $ftype" >> temp_workspace_checks/summary.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace_checks/resolved_candidates.txt
# Step 9: decision placeholder -> final single-line result
if grep -q 'regular file' temp_workspace_checks/summary.txt; then
  printf 'yes'
else
  printf 'no'
fi
"}
